home.intro: I work with data and artificial intelligence. Outside work I run, play and coach chess, and organise sports events.
home.aboutP1: I work in data and artificial intelligence. I studied at the Prague University of Economics and Business, where my master's thesis examined how Czech companies adopt AI in practice.
home.aboutP2: Outside work I'm a FIDE Master in chess, I run marathons, and for over four years I organised sports events for students at VŠE with the 4FIS association while serving as a student ambassador. I enjoy bringing people together, whether it's a tournament or a workshop. I like to travel and see how things are done elsewhere.

freeTime.title: Free time
freeTime.lead: Sport is my best way to recharge and clear my mind. I'm not about to crack the world's top 10 in any single one of these, but combine them all together, and maybe I'd have a shot. Below you'll find what I actually do, plus concrete tips and links.
freeTime.ctaLead: Football, volleyball, bouldering or a chess lesson: we can arrange a time.
freeTime.travelLead: For me travel isn't about collecting fridge magnets, but about collecting perspectives. Talking to people from the other side of the world pulls you out of stereotypes and out of your comfort zone, and shows you how many different ways there are to live a life. And when you stumble onto something great, it would be a shame to keep the tip to yourself.

freeTime.travelOutro: And I definitely don't plan on stopping. It's another topic I'm always happy to talk about, not just for small talk.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: I run this website as a private individual, not a company. Here's a plain summary of how I handle information you send me through it.
privacy.formsText: The site has three forms: booking, contact, and an inspiration tip. Submitted details (name, email, and message where relevant) are sent as a notification to my Discord and stored in a database I use to read and work with them.
privacy.storageText: Form data is stored with Sanity (CMS) and sent via Discord (notifications) and Resend (booking confirmation emails). I don't sell or share this data with any of these providers for advertising purposes.
privacy.protectionText: Forms are protected by Cloudflare Turnstile against automated spam. The site runs over a secure HTTPS connection.
privacy.rightsText: If you'd like me to delete information you submitted through any of the forms, email me at petr@hollan.eu and I'll take care of it.
privacy.disclaimer: I'm not a lawyer and this page isn't legal advice, it's a plain-language summary of how the site works.
